property_summary: For any inputs, C always calls the callee with selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) (so the recorder's recorded selector equals that constant); the mutant that uses transfer(address,address,uint256) will cause the recorder to observe a different selector for some inputs, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Change the keccak256 selector to use transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom, altering which external function is invoked and thus the returned result in some calls.
